status.indexIncomplete: Couldn't verify the drive index — changes are paused.

indexLoad.bannerBodyCached: Showing your cached files. The index will be verified automatically — uploads are paused until it succeeds.
indexLoad.bannerBodyEmpty: TeleDrive couldn't reach or verify the drive index. This is usually a temporary network issue. Tap Retry to try again.
indexLoad.changesPaused: The drive index isn't ready yet. Changes are paused.

reason.not_found: The index could not be assembled from available channel messages.
reason.partial_manifest: The newest index is incomplete — some chunk messages may be missing.
reason.timeout: Telegram took too long to respond. Check your connection.
reason.network: The storage channel couldn't be reached. Check your internet connection.

errors.noFolders: Pick at least one folder in Settings → Device Backup first.
errors.channelNotReady: Storage channel is not ready. Please complete first login.
errors.manifestCorrupt: Backup manifest is corrupt — refusing to upload until reviewed.
errors.sessionExpired: Telegram session expired. Reconnect your account in Settings → Telegram Account, then run the backup again.

upload.channelNotConfigured: Telegram storage channel is not configured. Please check settings.
upload.indexSaveFailed: Index save failed for "{{name}}" — refresh the drive.
upload.emptyFile: "{{name}}" is empty. Empty files (0 bytes) are not supported by Telegram.
upload.exceedsFreeLimit: "{{name}}" exceeds Telegram's ~2 GB upload limit for standard accounts (Telegram Premium supports up to ~4 GB).
upload.exceedsPremiumLimit: "{{name}}" exceeds Telegram's ~4 GB single-file upload limit.

download.failed: Failed to download file. Please check permissions and try again.

errors.mediaNotFound: Target file message or media not found on Telegram.

download.zipEmpty: No downloadable files found in the selection.

storage.saveFailed: Unable to save file to {{path}}. Please check storage permissions.
